# Effect: granular_delay

Granular delay: chops the delay line into small grains replayed randomly, which can shift pitch and scatter them for cloudy, shimmering ambience.

**Where to put it**: Good for ambient sections of pad, piano and vocals, often on a send bus. pitch_semitones 12 gives a "shimmer".

Latest parameters: `muser effects granular_delay` (MCP: `describe_effect`)

## Parameters

| Parameter | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `position_ms` | 250 | 0 – 1000 ms | How far back the grains are taken from |
| `spray_ms` | 50 | 0 – 500 ms | Random range of the grain position |
| `grain_ms` | 60 | 5 – 500 ms | Grain length. Short (10-30) sounds grainy; long (100+) is smoother |
| `density_hz` | 30 | 0.5 – 200 Hz | Grains per second |
| `pitch_semitones` | 0 | -24 – 24 semitones | Grain pitch shift. 12 = octave-up shimmer; -12 = deep |
| `pitch_spray` | 0 | 0 – 24 semitones | Random range of the pitch shift |
| `stereo_spread` | 0.5 | 0 – 1 | How far the grains spread left and right |
| `feedback` | 0 | 0 – 0.95 | Feedback. Higher = thicker, longer cloud |
| `mix` | 0.5 | 0 – 1 | Dry/wet mix. Use 1 on a send bus |

All parameters can be omitted and take their default when omitted; when a value is out of range, `muser validate` reports the exact location.

## Minimal example

```json
{ "type": "granular_delay", "pitch_semitones": 12, "feedback": 0.4, "mix": 0.4 }
```

## Scenario presets

- Shimmer (clouds an octave up)

  ```json
  {"type": "granular_delay", "pitch_semitones": 12, "feedback": 0.5, "mix": 0.4}
  ```

- Granular ambience (send bus for piano, pad)

  ```json
  {"type": "granular_delay", "grain_ms": 120, "spray_ms": 200, "density_hz": 20, "feedback": 0.4, "mix": 1.0}
  ```

- Glitchy fragments

  ```json
  {"type": "granular_delay", "grain_ms": 15, "density_hz": 80, "pitch_spray": 7, "mix": 0.5}
  ```

## Tips and common mistakes

- Most often used on a send bus (mix 1), followed by a reverb: ambient, cinematic.
- pitch_semitones 12 + a little feedback is the core sound of a shimmer reverb.
- The grain randomness uses a fixed seed, so the same project renders the same every time.
